}}Lord '''Carlomin''' is a [[Tairen]] lord.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Carlomin}}

== Appearance ==
He is tall and slender with a pointed beard "even more darkly luxuriant than [[Reimon]]'s"

== Activities ==
He is one of the young lords in the [[Stone of Tear]] playing cards with [[Mat Cauthon]] when the [[bubble of evil]] causes Mat's cards to come to life and attack Mat.{{ref/book|4|2}}

He later joins the [[Band of the Red Hand]] as a captain and travels to [[Murandy]] where King [[Roedran]] employs the Band to stay on the border. After the employment is completed, he sets off with a number of the Band's banners and finds Mat in [[Altara]].
